_about: Other people's work that XI: Forever Offline downloads from its official release at install time and never rehosts. Read by launcher_thirdparty.py. 'tag' pins the tested version; 'into' is the folder the files go to (ashita or kit); 'files' maps folders in the download to folders there; 'keep' lists folders whose existing files are never replaced (your settings).

source.note: main of 2026-11-11: v4.3.2.1 plus the fix for the November 2026 game update (target offset)

items.name: XI: Forever Offline server
items.author: XI: Forever Offline (based on Phoenix / LandSandBoat)
items.note: The prebuilt game server (a few hundred MB). Made with package_server.py and published as a release.

items.name: Microsoft Visual C++ runtime (x64)
items.author: Microsoft
items.note: The server programs and the database need it (version 14.40 or newer). Installs quietly; already there on most PCs.

items.name: Microsoft Visual C++ runtime (x86)
items.author: Microsoft
items.note: The game loader (xiloader) and Ashita need it (version 14.40 or newer). Installs quietly.

items.name: XIUI
items.author: Team XIUI
fixups: if slot == nil or slot >= 10 then return end

if slot == nil or slot >= 10 or struct.unpack('B', e.data, 0x15 + 1) == 1 then return end -- (XI: Forever Offline) Entry 1 = an item already in the pool, sent again when the party changes: not a new drop
loot pop-ups showed twice or three times when squad mates joined or zoned (Hasuko)

items.name: AutoBot
items.author: K0D3R
items.note: Used by the second window (dualbox).

items.name: mobdb
items.author: ThornyFFXI
items.note: The kit's build_mobdb_data.py fills in this server's monster data.

items.name: Cadence
items.author: KiplingFFXI
items.note: Auto-attack and resting timers. Made for Phoenix; installed switched off (tick it in the Addons list to load it).

items.name: Checkmate
items.author: KiplingFFXI
items.note: Advanced monster check (/check details on screen). Made for Phoenix; installed switched off (tick it in the Addons list to load it).

items.name: Momentum
items.author: KiplingFFXI
items.note: EXP, merit and Dynamis tracking bar. Made for Phoenix; installed switched off (tick it in the Addons list to load it).

items.name: FFXIPort
items.author: wildthing (wildcabbagepatch)
items.note: Made for XI: Forever Offline: a teleport window (/port) for the Home Points, Survival Guides, gate crystals and Runic Portals you have unlocked (1,000 gil or conquest points; free within a city). The server part ships with the server. Installed switched off (tick it in the Addons list to load it); it follows the Fast travel switch.

items.name: VanaFish
items.author: VanaDreams
items.license: used with the authors' permission (no licence file published)
items.note: A fishing bot from the VanaDreams team, shared with XI: Forever Offline with their permission: casts, waits for the bite and lands or releases by your rules, and stops itself when bags fill, you move, or a tell arrives. Installed switched off (tick it in the Addons list to load it); /vanafish opens its window.

items.name: VanaCam
items.author: VanaDreams (camera core from XICamera, BSD)
items.license: used with the authors' permission; XICamera core BSD (LICENSE.xicamera.txt ships with it)
items.note: Camera presets (close, adventure, far), a separate distance in combat, zoom in tight spaces and screen-aspect correction. From the VanaDreams team, shared with their permission. Installed switched off (tick it in the Addons list to load it); /vc ui opens its panel.

items.name: XISpeaks (NPC voices, beta)
items.author: lord-daeloth
items.license: GPL-3.0 (program); each voice has its own terms, see VOICE-LICENSES.md (some are noncommercial)
items.note: Reads NPC dialogue aloud with local voices; everything runs on your PC. BIG: about 2.9 GB to download (three files) and about 3.6 GB on disk, so it is never downloaded unless you press Install. Installed switched off: tick XISpeaks in the Addons list, and the launcher starts its voice program while your world runs. In game: /xis test, /xis voices, /xis stop. Suggested by delukard.
items.confirm: XISpeaks is about 2.9 GB to download (three files from its author's GitHub page) and takes about 3.6 GB of disk space once unpacked (about 6 GB free is needed while it installs). Download it now?
fixups: /xis voices stopped with an error on this Ashita

items.name: tCrossBar
items.author: ThornyFFXI
items.note: Controller macros with an on-screen crossbar (DualSense, Xbox and Switch Pro mappings). Needs a gamepad; type /tc in game to set it up.

items.name: Nameplate
items.author: Shirk (HealsCodes) / BunnyBox Productions
items.note: Version 0.60 ships with the kit: the project publishes 0.60 only as source code, and its last download (v0.5.1.0d) doesn't load on the current Ashita. GPL v3; source at the home page.

items.name: XIPivot
items.author: Renee Koecher (HealsCodes)
items.note: Loads DAT mods (UI, textures, music) from Ashita/polplugins/DATs without changing your game files. Off until you turn it on here; the change applies at the next PLAY. For HD texture packs press "HD packs and music...": it installs a pack you downloaded from Nexus Mods, and downloads the LoFi FFXI music for you (off until you turn it on).

items.name: TrueFPS
items.author: SQLCommit
items.note: Higher frame rates with the game still at normal speed, smoother motion, and no cutscene stalls at high FPS. Installed switched off (2026-11-26, Alis): tick it in the Addons list to load it; /truefps opens its settings. Don't load it together with the plain fps addon.

items.name: Mini game player
items.author: libretro / Gambatte
items.note: The 32-bit (x86) build: Ashita runs inside the 32-bit game. The build the Crystal Boy add-on was tested with ships with the kit (libretro's own build of 2026-10-27, GPL v2, source at github.com/libretro/gambatte-libretro): a newer build crashed the add-on.

items.name: xiloader (Phoenix)
items.author: Phoenix / LandSandBoat
items.note: Logs the game in to your own server; Ashita starts it from its bootloader folder.

items.name: umu-launcher
items.author: Open Wine Components (GloriousEggroll and others)
items.note: Starts the game with Proton outside Steam (the standard way, also used by Lutris and Heroic). Its first start downloads Valve's Steam Linux Runtime.

items.name: GE-Proton
items.author: GloriousEggroll (based on Valve's Proton and Wine)
items.note: Runs the Windows game (PlayOnline, FFXI, Ashita) on Linux and the Steam Deck. About 550 MB.

items.name: Era-DATs (Phoenix)
items.author: Phoenix
items.note: Game files that make the client match this era. Download, then 'Apply to the game': the files they replace are saved in dat-backup first (restore-original-dats.ps1 puts them back).

items.name: Ollama (local AI)
items.author: Ollama
items.note: Only for Living world + AI chat. Installs quietly; then get the AI model below.

linux.note: The local AI for squad and bot chat (about 1.4 GB, unpacked into the install folder's ollama folder). Needs a lot of memory: off by default on the Steam Deck.

items.name: AI model (gemma4:12b)
items.author: Google (Gemma), served by Ollama
items.note: What squad mates, crowds and bot players talk with. About 8 GB; needs Ollama first.
